name: omnibridge/twig
description: The Twig side of omnibridge: the contract a page rendered with Twig asks of any framework (path, url, asset, trans - omnisense/omnibridge's Urls and Translations), the Twig extension that provides it where the framework does not, and helpers.

suggest.omnisense/omnimap: Omnibridge\Twig\MapExtension: omnimap(view), omnimap_export(), omnimap_suppress() - a map's picture kept in the cache or the live map, and the buttons that change it
